workflow_read.status: five CE-IS1 tasks remain blocked; this document is a proposal, not native acceptance

policy.purpose: Reconcile old IS1 scope into the approved CE-COHERE outcomes while preserving evidence and explicit gaps.
policy.authority: Root applies task supersession/carry-forward through supported Project Control preview/apply. This file does not accept, complete, release, supersede, or alter any native task.
policy.evidence_rule: An ancestry relation, planning record, build log, prior test report, or agent summary is not by itself native task acceptance. Reuse source-bound evidence only within its recorded source, binary, input, device, and test scope.
policy.unknown_legacy_effects: Remain unverified and must not be replayed or represented as accepted.

reconciliation.old_outcome: Expose native mathematics through the existing framework adapter
old_acceptance_summary: Native forward, input VJP, parameter VJP, and requested JVP paths through supported framework calls.
Explicit parameter update ownership; tested shape, dtype, device, alias, and stale-tape failures; core remains buildable without Torch.

current_evidence.claim: The package has a real CPU FP32 Product2 Torch Module with first-order input and coefficient gradients, composed with ordinary Torch modules/autograd/optimizers.
Sparse support, indexed mechanisms, and prepared routing have concrete Torch adapters and bounded passing adapter or integration checks; these are separate facilities with their own contracts.
The current documented Torch API does not promise every native operator family, general JVP access, or uniform device/precision coverage.

reconciliation.recommendation: Supersede the blanket task with its implemented package/module slice carried into CE-COHERE-04 and the sparse/mechanism parameter-owner work in CE-COHERE-05/06. Retain feature-specific Torch gaps as future work only when a concrete consumer and acceptance contract are named. Do not require wrapping all native families as a package-closure criterion.
unresolved_gaps: Native JVP is not established through the general Torch API.
Not all native operation families have Torch wrappers; no uniform wrapper claim.
Recheck only changed interfaces against old shape/dtype/device/alias/stale-tape acceptance where applicable.

reconciliation.old_outcome: Measure complete-path performance and extension friction
old_acceptance_summary: Cold/warm/training/changing-structure comparisons include bytes, launches, and quality.
Add a custom packer and new operator without central rewrites or mandatory hot-path abstraction overhead.
Select only from comparable measured evidence and retain fallbacks.

current_evidence.claim: Main sparse performance records compare bounded regimes and complete relevant regions; they preserve alternatives and do not justify one universal sparse-format/strategy choice.

Prepared routing has a source/binary-bound final 16-test pass, exact prepared CUDA correctness, and separate memcheck/racecheck/synccheck passes; its owner-cold lifecycle benchmark compares prepared, Python, and dense routes over four shapes/horizons.

Prepared-routing evidence supports only its measured synthetic route-table reuse regimes; score refresh is shared/excluded, one query synchronization remains, and it is not biological or full-model training evidence.
The integrated native qualification receipt covers CPU/static builds and host/installed SDK consumers only; it explicitly says no device execution was performed by those commands.

reconciliation.recommendation: Supersede the broad campaign task by carrying mechanism-specific performance boundaries into CE-COHERE-06 and final source/package qualification into CE-COHERE-09. Retain the custom-packer/new-operator friction exercise only if a concrete next extension is selected; do not make it a universal package gate.
unresolved_gaps: No single integrated cold/warm/training/changing-structure campaign is evidenced here.
